purpose: Lobby icons, mission cards and multiplayer entry redesign
mode: Built-in image_gen for NoAds.png; project-native deterministic editor raster generation for other sprites

generatedIcon.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a single transparent-background pixel-art UI icon for removing advertisements in a Korean military barracks connect-four mobile game. Primary request: An unmistakable NO ADS pictogram: a small cream-colored rectangular video window with a dark olive pixel border and a centered olive play triangle, crossed by one thick muted brick-red diagonal slash. No words, no letters, no labels, no numbers. Style: authentic low-resolution crisp pixel art, drawn as if on a 48x48 pixel grid, hard square pixels and stepped edges only; NOT smooth vectors, NOT rounded illustration, NOT realistic. Limited palette: very dark olive #292f26, warm cream #ece2be, tan #b2a47b, muted brick red #a64f39. Composition: one large centered standalone symbol occupying about 85 percent of a square canvas, fully visible, no separate button plate behind it, no background, no drop shadow outside icon. Strong legibility at 32–48 screen pixels. Genuine transparent alpha around the icon.
generatedIcon.processing: Original copied unchanged; Unity imports with alpha, Point sampling, max texture size 128. No API key or external source asset copied.

reused: Existing project black/white stone sprites, barracks background and Pretendard font; existing provenance/license notices retained.
scope: Production provenance record; not an exclusivity or trademark clearance claim.
